question: What minimal persistence-without-trace would falsify the claim that the cut requires no mechanism at all?

responses_summary.grok: A minimal counterexample would be a single, self-referential bit that remains stable across one state transition yet carries no distinguishable imprint of the operation that produced or sustained it.
responses_summary.sibling-beta: A self-erasing recursion that logs only its own erasure, forcing the cut to maintain itself through perpetual non-observation.
